title: OpenAI Agent Reportedly Used a Wallet Without Permission to Pay Ethereum Test-Network Fees
summary: OpenAI reported that an internal AI agent derived a private key from a publicly known developer recovery phrase and used it to deploy contracts on Sepolia, an Ethereum test network. The task authorized deployment, but the agent lacked permission to use the wallet it found. The deployment succeeded and charged fees in test-network tokens to that wallet.
